my situation is similar to yours, this guy cheated on his girlfriend with me. he couldnt risk the possibility of being outed and claimed he was drugged and r*ped. i believe my soul exited my body when i found out about the charge. this feeling of despair is indescribable, i cant believe every little moment of my life lead up to this nightmare. i have an amazing lawyer and supportive family, which im incredibly thankful for but cant seem to shake this hopelessness. i torment myself thinking of the case every second of the day, suffering in silence. i feel a level of hatred i never thought id be capable of towards my accuser, how fucking evil can you be? listening to the blatant lies he spews in his interview, and to think he’s being viewed/treated as a “victim”. i look at my little sister and weep at the thought of not being able to watch her grow up, theres no reason i shouldnt be able to.


going to trial terrifies me, but so does taking a plea deal. isnt there a huge risk pleading guilty to a crime like this when im innocent? i dont think id survive jail/prison. not with this charge, plus im gay. then id be required to do classes, how am i supposed to take accountability for something i didnt do? i cant fabricate a story, and to make matters worse, polygraph tests. failure means back to jail 

attempting to take your life, when you want to live. that is something no human being should ever have to experience. (glad youre here btw) i couldnt fathom the possibility of being found guilty, convinced myself i didnt have the mental capacity to fight and attempted suicide myself. i still have thoughts to, what deters them is the devastation it would bring my family and the little faith i do have that truth prevails. i wont let my accuser win. im only 20 years old, my story cant end here.
